During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained a '''stronghold''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. The stronghold was located atop a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] not far from the world's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]]. In [[3660 BBY]], the stronghold fell to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Ord Radama]].
